Name: Punk Abigail
Author: JefGrizli
Description:
[b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZWBdMB2r/punk-abigail.png[/img]
Ever wanted Abigail to be a little more [color=#ffff00]PUNK[/color], visually? Hi!
If you screamed  [font=Times New Roman][color=#000000]NO![/color][/font]  at your screen, why did you click it?

Out of the box, only compatible with SDV 1.6+




[img]https://i.postimg.cc/HVSjwwWp/config-options.png[/img]
[font=Times New Roman][color=#000000][size=3]HAIRCUT[/size][/color][/font]
[color=#ffff00]LONG[/color], [color=#ffff00]SHORT[/color]; default: [color=#ffff00]LONG[/color]
Select whether you want the long or short cut.

[font=Times New Roman][color=#000000][size=3]SHAVE COLOUR[/size][/color][/font]
[color=#ffff00]BROWN[/color], [color=#ffff00]BLUe[/color]; default: [color=#ffff00]BROWN[/color]
Select either her natrual light brown or dyed blue for the shaved side.
[color=#ffff00][size=1](Both are canon, fight me!)[/size][/color]


[size=4]OPTiONAL![/size]
[font=Times New Roman][color=#000000][size=3]SIDE TUFT
[/size][/color][/font][color=#ffff00]TRUe[/color], [color=#ffff00]FALSe[/color]; default: [color=#ffff00]FALSe
[/color]﻿Leaves a tuft of hair over Abby's free ear. Affects portraits only.




[img]https://i.postimg.cc/KRcR3q2q/what-next.png[/img]
[font=Times New Roman][color=#000000][size=3]SEASONAL OUTFITS, RIGHT?[/size][/color][/font]
I do have ideas for the other seasons and Spirit's Eve.
If you have an outfit in mind you want to see Punk Abigail wear,
put it in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25452/?tab=forum&topic_id=14348873]comments[/url].

Should I have already released the Seasonal Outfits update,
I might implement your suggestion as an [color=#ffff00]ALTeRNATiVe![/color] option.

I may or may not have something in the works to replace the flute,
but it's a long way to go. Like music. Just don't expect it.[/b]
